9f1d7df4: ;
This routine allows a new deficiency to be added to the DEFICIENCY file (#393.3).
An initial check for the '?', '^' to quit, length restrictions, and format is performed.
Input is then gathered for the following fields:
.02 (ABBREVIATION)
.06 (CATEGORY)
.07 (TRACK?)
.08 (STANDARD?)
The new entry is added using the DIC utility.
After successful addition, the fields are updated with the entered values using
the DIE utility.
422fae66: ; Get full screen mode and initialize variables.
1f46b29b: ; Get and validate new deficiency name. Check length, format, and if user wants to quit.
06d6e571: ; Get and validate track indicator input.
c66c0c95: ; Get and validate standard indicator input.
8821d36c: ; Add new entry to DEFICIENCY file (#393.3) using DIC utility.
f968c472: ; Update fields of new entry using DIE utility.
0bdec05b: ; Loop back to allow entry of another deficiency.
552e67a0: ; Clean up variables, set full screen mode, and quit.
